test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tok_log_lines (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tok_log_lines SELECT concat('2024-01-01 12:00:00.', toString(number % 1000), ' [thread-', toString(number % 64), '] INFO Request processed user_id=', toString(number), ' method=GET path=/api/v1/items/', hex(cityHash64(number)), ' status=200 latency_ms=', toString(number % 500), ' ua="Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64)" ok') FROM numbers(500000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tok_utf8 (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tok_utf8 SELECT concat('Много лет спустя, стоя у стены в ожидании расстрела, полковник Аурелиано Буэндиа вспомнил тот далекий вечер. ', toString(number)) FROM numbers(300000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM tok_log_lines WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s, 'splitByString', [' ', '=', ',', '"'])) SETTINGS max_threads = {threads}
SELECT count() FROM tok_log_lines WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s, 'splitByRegexp', '[ =,"]')) SETTINGS max_threads = {threads}
SELECT count() FROM tok_log_lines WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s, 'splitByRegexp', '[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+')) SETTINGS max_threads = {threads}
SELECT count() FROM tok_log_lines WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s, 'splitByRegexp', '[A-Za-z0-9._-]+', true)) SETTINGS max_threads = {threads}
SELECT count() FROM tok_log_lines WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s, 'splitByRegexp', '\\s*=\\s*')) SETTINGS max_threads = {threads}
SELECT count() FROM tok_log_lines WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s, 'splitByRegexp', '([a-z_]+)=', true)) SETTINGS max_threads = {threads}
SELECT count() FROM tok_utf8 WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s, 'splitByRegexp', '[ ,.]+')) SETTINGS max_threads = {threads}
SELECT count() FROM tok_utf8 WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s, 'splitByRegexp', '[^ ,.]+', true)) SETTINGS max_threads = {threads}
SELECT count() FROM tok_log_lines WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s, 'splitByRegexp', '\\s*=\\s*| |\\] ')) SETTINGS max_threads = {threads}
SELECT count() FROM tok_log_lines WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s, 'splitByRegexp', '[ =,"]+?')) SETTINGS max_threads = {threads}
SELECT count() FROM tok_utf8 WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s, 'splitByRegexp', '[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+')) SETTINGS max_threads = {threads}
